qusanna-fi-liqii.title: Savings & Loan

qusanna-fi-liqii.overview: Members can access loans by saving in different ways.  WALIN SACCO pays 7% interest on mandatory and voluntary adult savings and 10.5% for children's savings.

subTypes.name: Mandatory Savings
subTypes.desc: Members save 500 ETB every month continuously. Mandatory savings can only be withdrawn when membership is resigned.

subTypes.name: Voluntary Savings
subTypes.desc: Members may save any amount they wants with the cooperative and can withdraw it at any time.

subTypes.name: Children's Savings
subTypes.desc: Children can save money through their parents or guardians. Children's savings start at 500 ETB.

subTypes.name: Productive Savings
subTypes.desc: Members who maintain 25% continuous savings for three to four months or more can access a loan.

tiers.label: Category one
tiers.condition: 25% savings continuously for 3–4 months
